name: Label Collage
tagline: Label-maker tape, a hand-cut coral star and grainy night-sky paper, slapped together by hand.
description: Tactile scrapbook look: warm cream paper and speckled, halftoned indigo night paper, navy Dymo tape with embossed mono text slapped on by hand, rough coral cut-outs and hand-drawn circles, all under a film of grain. The preview is a journaling app with a spinning asterisk, a sketched jar and a circled quote.

display.usage: Embossed label-maker tape text, 28px for scattered labels, 38–46px for key lines, 140px for the wordmark

body.usage: Quotes, wavy lines and spoke labels on night paper, 23–40px in #eef0f6

accent.usage: Coral handwriting for the jar label, dates and the URL, 40–60px

transitions: hard cut between cream paper and indigo night paper
labels scatter outward and fade (0.42s power2.in) right before a cut
the hero shape scales up and fades as the scene leaves
textAnimations: tape slap: scale 1.4 → 1 with back.out(2.2) in 0.3s, 0.1s apart, each tape pre-rotated ±2–8°
wavy line: per-character sine offset (±38px, ±12°) driven by a tweened phase
spoke labels pop at the ends of radiating lines that draw out from the centre
coral ellipse draws around a quote with stroke-dashoffset 1 → 0

rhythm.notes: Four scenes of ~2s: build-up of slapped labels, a night scene with jar + wave + circled quote, a radiating spokes scene, a cream end card. Something lands every 0.1–0.3s while a scene builds.

guide:
- Look only: build the user's own subject in this visual language; don't reuse the example's scene.
- Two papers only: cream #ece3cd and indigo night #34497f with feTurbulence clouds, sparse white specks and a halftone dot gradient on the lower half. Hard-cut between them; keep a full-frame multiply grain (~0.7) on top of everything.
- Words are Dymo label tape: #263a6c strip, Space Mono 700 in #e8ebf1 with an embossed text-shadow, slightly torn clip-path corners, a 5px halftone drop shadow offset 7/8px, and a fixed rotation between −8° and 8°. Never straight, never more than one line.
- Tapes slap in with scale 1.4 → 1, back.out(2.2), 0.3s, 0.1s apart; before a cut they scatter outward from the centre with power2.in and fade.
- Draw the subject as rough paper cut-outs and simple hand sketches (round-capped strokes roughened with feDisplacementMap) in coral #e5735b, navy and cream; one hero shape per scene.
- Coral marks are hand-drawn: overshooting ellipses, underlines, boxes, drawn with stroke-dashoffset in ~0.5s power2.inOut.
- On night paper set lowercase Space Mono 400 sentences on a sine wave (per-character offset driven by a tweened phase) or as radiating spoke labels; Caveat for small handwritten notes.
- Optional motif: a rough-cut coral 12-arm asterisk that spins slowly with ease "none", or a 5–7 dot constellation. Keep copy small, human and specific.
example: The preview is a scrapbook for a journaling app: label tapes slap on, a coral asterisk spins, a sketched jar fills with tape, and a quote gets circled. Don't copy this scene unless asked.
